answer: Joining requires three established, non-kin sponsors, each locking a marble of stake equal to three times their eight-epoch median fee. Those sponsors form a ridge of residual liability: if the newcomer is later shown to share keys, funders, or identical vote patterns with another identity, a five-peer summit slashes every sponsor bond plus the applicant and bars all of them for sixteen epochs. A farm must recruit costly, slashable sponsors per clone, and peers enforce it by publishing collision proofs before they seal.
